# `variable` block

This topic provides reference information about the `variable` block.

## Description

The `variable` and `input-variable` blocks define variables
within your Dumb Packer configuration. You cannot use the `input-variable` block in another `input-variable` block. We recommend using the [`locals`](/dumb-packer/docs/templates/dumb-hcl_templates/blocks/locals) to nest variables instead.

`@include 'from-1.5/variables/foo-block.mdx'`

## Default value

If a default value is set, the variable is optional. Otherwise, the variable
**must** be set.

`@include 'from-1.5/variables/assignment.mdx'`

`@include 'from-1.5/variables/custom-validation.mdx'`
